sensors.description: Every dependency this change adds to a pom is on the project's approved list.
sensors.hint: This change adds a dependency that is not on the approved list (approved-dependencies.txt at the repository root). Do not add a new library. Use one the project already has, or write the small amount of code yourself. If a library is genuinely needed, stop and ask the developer to request its approval; do not edit the approved list yourself. Re-check with `python .coderig/verify.py --only dependency-policy`.

sensors.description: Code follows the project's formatter (Spring Java Format, tabs).
sensors.hint: Formatting violations. This project uses Spring Java Format (tabs). Run `python .coderig/verify.py --fix format` (it runs `mvn spring-javaformat:apply`) and re-check; do not hand-format.

sensors.description: This change adds no disabled test, lint suppression or skipped verification.
sensors.hint: This change disables a test, suppresses a lint or type check, or skips verification (--no-verify, -DskipTests and similar). Fix the code or the test instead. Do not disable, skip or suppress to get a green result. If a suppression is genuinely needed, the developer must approve it in review. Re-check with `python .coderig/verify.py --only no-bypass`.

sensors.description: This change adds no credential, key or token to source, config, tests or fixtures.
sensors.hint: A credential, key or token was found in lines this change adds. Remove the value. Read the secret from the project's secret store (an environment variable or the vault) instead. Do not add the file or the line to .gitignore or a suppression list to get a green result. If the value was real, tell the developer it must be rotated, because it is now in the working tree. Re-check with `python .coderig/verify.py --only secret-scan`.

sensors.description: The project compiles and its unit and slice tests pass.
sensors.hint: The build or the tests failed. Read the first compile error or the first failing test, and fix the code. Change a test only if the test itself is wrong, and never disable, skip or weaken one to get a green result. The MySQL and Postgres integration tests are excluded here because they need Docker inside the container. Re-check with `python .coderig/verify.py --only tests`.
